description: Search US land for sale by state, county, city, ZIP, keyword, price, acreage, land type and 70 land tags; or fetch specific listing URLs/IDs. Three cookieless sources, no proxy required.

city.description: City name, e.g. `Fredericksburg`. Use with a state for an exact LandSearch city page.
city.title: City

county.description: County name, with or without the word County, e.g. `Gillespie` or `Gillespie County`. Use with a state for an exact LandSearch county page.
county.title: County

dataSource.description: `auto` tries LandSearch, then LandHub, then LandCentury until it finds matching listings. Choose a source to force it.
dataSource.title: Data source

hasStructure.description: Filter listings by whether they include a house or building.
hasStructure.title: Has house or building

includeDetails.description: Visit each listing's detail page for description, coordinates, features, taxes, history and broker contact. Turn off for a faster list-only run.
includeDetails.title: Include full details

includeParcelBoundary.description: Opt-in: fetch the public LandHub/id.land map-share GeoJSON and add the parcel Polygon/MultiPolygon as `parcelBoundary` when available. Adds one request per LandHub listing.
includeParcelBoundary.title: Include parcel boundary

landType.description: Broad land classification. `any` leaves it unset.
landType.title: Land type

listingFormat.description: Sale, lease or auction listings. `any` includes every format.
listingFormat.title: Listing format

listingIds.description: LandSearch or LandHub numeric listing IDs. LandCentury IDs need a slug; use byUrls for those.
listingIds.title: Listing IDs (mode=byIds)

listingStatus.description: Filter by reported status: active, under contract or sold. Availability depends on the source.
listingStatus.title: Listing status

listingUrls.description: Direct listing URLs from LandSearch, LandHub or LandCentury, e.g. `https://www.landsearch.com/properties/.../4145054`. LandWatch/Land.com detail URLs are accepted by the schema but cannot be fetched cookielessly.
listingUrls.title: Listing URLs (mode=byUrls)

maxAcres.description: Drop listings larger than this acreage.
maxAcres.title: Maximum acres

maxBuildingSqft.description: Only listings whose house/building is at most this large.
maxBuildingSqft.title: Maximum building sq ft

maxDaysOnMarket.description: Drop listings first seen longer ago than this many days.
maxDaysOnMarket.title: Maximum days on market

maxPrice.description: Drop listings priced above this amount.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (USD)

maxPricePerAcre.description: Drop listings above this price per acre.
maxPricePerAcre.title: Maximum price per acre (USD)

maxYearBuilt.description: Only listings with a house/building built in or before this year.
maxYearBuilt.title: Maximum year built

minAcres.description: Drop listings smaller than this acreage.
minAcres.title: Minimum acres

minBathrooms.description: Only listings with at least this many bathrooms. Decimals allowed (e.g. 1.5).
minBathrooms.title: Minimum bathrooms

minBedrooms.description: Only listings with at least this many bedrooms.
minBedrooms.title: Minimum bedrooms

minBuildingSqft.description: Only listings whose house/building is at least this large.
minBuildingSqft.title: Minimum building sq ft

minPrice.description: Drop listings priced below this amount.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (USD)

minPricePerAcre.description: Drop listings below this price per acre.
minPricePerAcre.title: Minimum price per acre (USD)

minYearBuilt.description: Only listings with a house/building built in or after this year.
minYearBuilt.title: Minimum year built

mode.description: What to fetch. `search` uses the location/filter fields below; `byUrls` reads listingUrls; `byIds` reads listingIds.
enumTitles: Search listings by location and filters
mode.title: Mode

requireImages.description: Drop listings with no photo URLs.
requireImages.title: Require images

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword matched against title, description, features, county, city and tags, e.g. `hunting`, `creek`, `owner financing`.
searchQuery.title: Keyword

searchUrls.description: Optional legacy search URLs. LandWatch/Land.com category or state URLs are mapped to the equivalent LandSearch location; LandSearch, LandHub and LandCentury search URLs are used directly. Direct listing URLs are also accepted. Leave empty to use the location and filter fields.
searchUrls.title: Search URLs (optional)

sortBy.description: Sort results. Sources that cannot sort server-side are sorted locally over the fetched page set.
sortBy.title: Sort order

state.description: US state to search. Leave as Any state for nationwide results.
state.title: State

tag.description: One of the 70 land tags LandSearch publishes (hunting, waterfront, owner financing, timberland, …). `any` leaves it unset.
tag.title: Land feature tag

zipCode.description: 5-digit US ZIP code, e.g. `78624`. Overrides city/county/state when set.
zipCode.title: ZIP code

title: US Land for Sale Listings Scraper Input
